subtitle: A former fishing village on Rio Grande do Norte's coast, built around red sandstone cliffs that keep collapsing on the people who come to see them.
spike_statement: Pipa's red sandstone cliffs are its top tourist draw and a documented killer: a 2020 collapse killed a family of three; a 2025 decree fenced them off.

levers.photo_tone: Ochre-red Barreiras Formation cliff faces against white sand and turquoise water, eucalyptus-and-rope safety fencing visible along the clifftop edge
